decision_summary: Freeze the untested allocation of 65% skew-restricted and 35% unrestricted search, motivated only by corrected development comparisons. Retain tested tabu, restart and perturbation defaults. Impose no balance restriction: at n=18 balanced optima exist, but not all optima are balanced. The audited skew runs were entirely skew-restricted; the diagnostic default did not describe actual allocation. No holdout validation exists.
